procedural_matters: The hearing started at 20:15 and was suspended for 20 minutes, by request of Race Committee.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
USA 39 was represented by Audrey Roachel.
Race Committee was represented by Francisco Jauregui.
Leocapio Sanchez Soto on the port finishing vessel gave evidence as a witness for Race Committee
Ivo Ferreira on the starboard finishing vessel provided video evidence as a witness for Race Committee
facts: Race 3, blue fleet, wind 12 knots, swell 1,5 meters
USA 39 was on the last beat, approaching the finishing line on port tack
When USA 39 was 1 boat length leeward of the port finishing vessel, the vessel slightly drifted and was then motoring slowly to maintain the position

USA 39 kept sailing, at the middle of the finishing line USA 39 luffed until passing head to wind, then reaching close-hauled on starboard at the middle of the finishing line, crossing it and finished the race.
conclusions: USA 39's place in race 3 was not made significantly worse. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
